# Notice

This package follows PermissionFlow
(https://github.com/jaywcjlove/PermissionFlow, at cb96db4), a Swift
package for macOS: what its guide does (System Settings opened at the
page, a panel under its window that follows it, with the app to drag into
the list, and which closes with it), the panes it covers and which of
them take a drag, the pasteboard types of the dragged app, the panel's
geometry and text, and how it tells the status of each permission. The
code is MyGo's own, in Go: none of PermissionFlow's is copied.
